name: Hub height
note: Small wind turbine tower height assumption

name: Turbulence intensity
note: Mild synthetic turbulence added to 15-minute mean wind

name: Turbulence max deviation
note: Maximum synthetic wind deviation ratio when turbulence is enabled

name: Blade radius
note: Swept area determines captured wind power

note: 2 kW wind branch matched to 370 V bus

note: No generation below this wind speed

name: Rated speed
note: Pitch limiting starts near rated condition

name: Cut-out speed
note: Generation is stopped above this wind speed

name: Actual aero capture efficiency
note: Practical blade/turbulence correction applied to actual P_aero, not to ideal MPP reference

note: 1 means lambda/Cp/k are updated during runtime

name: Nominal tip-speed ratio
note: Fallback value when dynamic optimum is disabled

name: Nominal power coefficient
note: Fallback value when dynamic optimum is disabled

name: Lambda search minimum
note: Runtime Cp peak search lower bound

name: Lambda search maximum
note: Runtime Cp peak search upper bound

name: Nominal torque coefficient

note: Low-speed aerodynamic starting torque before Region-2 MPPT engages
